x: PARAGON---Yet another member to pull off a school double, Jim McAffee won the 880yds (2:22) and the mile (5:12). He is only a junior boy at present so there is much improvement ahead.
1500: · 1. C. Taylor (Mit) 4:08.0, J. McAffee  4:29.1,  S. Holmes  4:42.0
Our interest in the track was equally rewarding, Jimmy McAffee showing tremendous form in coming through the field and taking a commanding lead to win the Youths 1000m in 2m49.2s.
Stephen also finished third in the triple-jump, and Jim McAffee was third in the 1,500m. The Club had only a few representatives in the boys' events, but they look a promising bunch.
